integrity_notes: All claims in the result follow from explicit finite-field orthogonality identities. Proof, code, normalizations, and the included test results were reviewed together; independent scientific audit was not performed. Earlier equivalent formulations may exist.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite Heisenberg groups of odd prime-power field order and the specifically defined coordinate-modulated right-translation transform of horizontal-constant windows. It does not establish a global minimum-entropy theorem, phase retrieval, or equivalence to Schrödinger-representation STFTs. The computational tests cover prime fields and are supplementary to an exact proof.
title: Central-profile factorization and quadratic-chirp spreading for finite Heisenberg spectrograms
